prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `mod_pow(base, exp, modulus)` in src/lib.rs using modular exponentiation, so large exponents do not overflow. It returns `base^exp mod modulus`; `mod_pow(x, 0, m)` is `1 mod m`, and `modulus == 1` returns 0. A modulus of 0 must panic with `modulus`. Keep the public signature and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
